value: (1) history_integrity, trouble_panel_surfaces_live_troubles are clock probes (Akien's group-2 list, 2026-09-30). (2) The heartbeat calls on_pulse(now, {}) once per 60s beat and holds the module between beats, re-loading it when cairn/devices/cairn/groundloop/pulse.py changes, which resets crossing memory; a reset re-pokes a still-true condition once, which is acceptable and matches a loop restart under the old runner. (3) A probe's poke needs a bus; connect_bus(devices=[], beat=False) gives one without beating. (4) The probe files are unchanged; only who fires them moves.

(a) The helper must record a named probe with no module as missing rather than raise, so a renamed probe is loud on the heartbeat's record. (b) What the pulse returns lands in liveness.json through json.dumps(default=str); the shim's pulse record is plain dicts, so this holds. (c) The nine other owner tickets depend on this one; they are cast now and wait for it at BUILDME.

LOADING: import each <folder>/probes/<name>.py by path with a synthetic module name, read module.PROBE. BUS: from cairn.tools.bus_client import connect_bus; bus = connect_bus(devices=[], beat=False), once per process, lazily on the first beat. TESTS use a stub bus with a post() that records. DO NOT touch the heartbeat, the probe files, or other devices' folders.
